what: Wanderer 3.1 RC1: author-tested synth for low-vision musicians, designed with low vision in mind. Protect an Anchor, evolve a Layer, 150 sounds, Scatter and Pattern, six colour themes with a high-contrast option, Zoom and clear knob controls. The first start erases saved Wanderer projects and settings; keep a 1.4 file for rollback.
author: Nicholas James / Low Vision Music
